after.rosterkit/notices.py:
"""Plain text notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed

# ---
def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student, days missed and the dates in order."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ProjectError("attendance marks belong to a different student")
    missed = days_missed(marks)
    if not missed:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to write a notice about")
    count = len(missed)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    dates = ", ".join(stamp.isoformat() for stamp in missed)
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian,\n"
        f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {count} {unit} of school.\n"
        f"Date(s) absent: {dates}"
    )
after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Rivera", "Ana", "A")


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 10), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 8), "present"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Rivera", text)
        self.assertIn("2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-03, 2026-09-10", text)

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("s2", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        marks = [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "excused")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)
